change.scope: PVKSAM post-adsorption restrained optimization: H0, post-protonation, and post-cycle relaxation

supporting_case.classification: one completed post-protonation ITO case; not a universal calibration

feedback_case.old_result: not converged under the then-locked 0.01 eV/A target

interpretation: The related 2Nap-Ac case provides an empirical operating precedent at a similar total system size, but it is a post-protonation case and does not establish transferability to every H0 geometry.
The force target is an optimizer stopping criterion, not a standalone claim of physical accuracy; all locked geometry and restraint audits remain mandatory.
The earlier 4Nap-Ac Stage 13 result remains a failure under its original 0.01 eV/A and 2000-step contract. It is not retrospectively relabeled as a pass.
